queries.query: ("large language model" OR LLM OR "generative model") AND (NetOps OR "network operations" OR "network configuration" OR "network change" OR routing OR "switch config") AND (failure OR error OR misconfiguration OR hallucinat* OR unsafe OR unexpected OR "incorrect action")
queries.rationale: Capture empirical and conceptual reports of LLM-generated NetOps failures, hallucinations, and incorrect/unsafe actions to define the phenomenon and observed failure modes.

queries.query: (agentic OR "autonomous agent" OR "LLM agent" OR AutoGPT OR agent) AND (network OR NetOps OR "network operations" OR orchestration OR automation) AND (failure OR safety OR trust OR reliability)
queries.rationale: Find literature on agentic or tool-using LLMs applied to operational automation (agents that perform NetOps actions) and their safety/reliability concerns.

queries.query: "intent to configuration" OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "natural language to configuration" OR NL2Config OR "language-to-config" AND (network OR router OR switch OR firewall OR acl OR BGP OR OSPF)
queries.rationale: Target work on translating human intent/NL into concrete network configurations — core mechanism where mapping errors and semantic gaps arise.

queries.query: (hallucinat* OR "confidence calibration" OR "overconfidence" OR "miscalibration") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative model") AND (structured OR "code generation" OR "configuration generation" OR "program synthesis")
queries.rationale: Investigate mechanisms behind hallucination and calibration issues when LLMs produce structured outputs like configs, code, or CLI commands.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "synthesize-verify-repair" OR "synthesize-verify" OR "generate-verify" AND (network OR "network configuration" OR NetOps OR router OR "firewall rules")
queries.rationale: Locate architectures that pair generative models with validators or repair loops (generate→verify→repair) applicable to ensuring correct network changes.

queries.query: (formal verification OR model checking OR SMT OR theorem proving) AND (network configuration OR forwarding correctness OR safety properties OR reachability) AND (Veriflow OR Anteater OR Batfish OR "network verification")
queries.rationale: Find deterministic and formal validators used to check network configurations and properties that can serve as mitigations or validators for LLM outputs.

queries.query: (guardrail* OR constraint* OR "controlled generation" OR "constrained decoding" OR "output schema" OR "structured decoding") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative model") AND (configuration OR code OR CLI OR "structured output")
queries.rationale: Survey methods for constraining LLM outputs (decoding constraints, templates, schemas) to reduce harmful or invalid NetOps actions.
source_preferences: engineering blog posts (only as pointer to primary paper or repo)

queries.query: (benchmark OR dataset OR evaluation) AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps OR "OpsEval" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench")
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmarks/datasets used to evaluate LLMs for networking/AIOps and assess their scope, limitations, and relevance for operational validity.

queries.query: ("benchmark validity" OR "evaluation validity" OR "external validity" OR "construct validity" OR "dataset bias") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR benchmark OR evaluation) AND (AIOps OR NetOps OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Target meta-evaluation literature on pitfalls in benchmarking LLMs and AIOps—useful for judging whether a benchmark meaningfully reflects operational risk.

queries.query: (Mininet OR GNS3 OR CORE OR NS3 OR "network testbed" OR emulator OR simulator) AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR automation OR orchestration OR NetOps) AND (evaluation OR experiment OR "case study")
queries.rationale: Find methodological precedents for experimental evaluation of automated network changes in emulated/simulated environments suitable for reproducible study.

queries.query: (red-team OR adversarial OR robustness OR stress-test OR "adversarial evaluation") AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration OR automation)
queries.rationale: Locate adversarial evaluation and robustness testing methods for LLM-driven operational agents to understand how failures can be elicited and measured.

queries.query: (AIOps OR "LLM for operations" OR "LLMs for DevOps" OR "LLM-assisted troubleshooting" OR "LLM for monitoring") AND (case study OR user study OR "field study" OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Survey applied and empirical work that examines how LLMs assist operations (monitoring, triage, remediation) to identify transferables and evaluation methods.

queries.query: ("tool use" OR "tool-augmented" OR "toolformer" OR "LLM+tool" OR "chain-of-tools" OR "planner-executor") AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (automation OR agent OR orchestration)
queries.rationale: Capture literature on LLMs augmented with external tools (APIs, validators, simulators) and related agent architectures, which are central to safe NetOps automation designs.

inclusion_criteria: Primary research articles, system papers, or authoritative technical reports describing LLMs/agents applied to network operations, configuration synthesis, validation, or automation.
Preprints (arXiv) and peer-reviewed papers from 2015–2026, with allowance for older foundational networking verification work (e.g., Batfish/Veriflow papers).
Works that present methods, toolchains, datasets, experiments, benchmarks, case studies, or formal verification techniques relevant to NetOps and LLMs.
Publicly available artifacts (code, datasets, repos) when cited, to permit independent verification.
English-language sources; non-English allowed if accompanied by an English abstract and high relevance.
exclusion_criteria: Marketing materials, vendor-only product pages, or unverifiable proprietary reports without sufficient technical detail.
Blog posts or news articles used as sole evidence unless they link to a primary paper or publicly available artifact.

Works outside the scope of operational network configuration/NetOps (pure NLP / generative-model theory papers without clear NetOps applicability) unless they introduce mitigation/mechanism directly transferable to NetOps.
Very small-scale anecdotal notes without methodology or datasets (unless they point to a broader empirical study).
date_rationale: Emphasize literature from 2015–2026 because LLM-driven NetOps and generative-agent toolchains emerged rapidly after 2020; include 2010–2015 and earlier foundational networking verification/synthesis work selectively (e.g., Batfish, Veriflow, Anteater) to ground mitigations. Prioritize the most recent 2019–2026 work for LLM-specific mechanisms, benchmarks, and agent architectures to ensure coverage of current models, evaluation practices, and known failure modes.
